title: Adaptive knowledge Chatbot – RAG
description: Enterprise ready chatbot with intelligent department routing using semantic embeddings and keyword matching. Implemented semantic question deduplication & reduced redundant queries by generating canonical summaries. Built an advanced admin dashboard with RBAC, real-time analytics, response monitoring, department-specific admins, and dynamic knowledge-base creation from file(pdf,docx,txt) or text data, including admin FAQs.

title: Smart Resume Parser – ML+NLP
description: Built resume parser with intelligent layout detection, achieving 95+% section accuracy across multi-column formats. Implemented adaptive document pipelines with Transformer-based NER to extract experience, skills, contact info.

title: Newzzy – Personalized News Feed
description: Developed a feature-rich news aggregation and AI-powered recommendation platform with JWT authentication. Integrated keyword-based personalization, saved articles, and likes/dislikes, User Streaks, User Activity, Sharing. Built modular APIs, responsive UI, dark mode support, and deployed on Vercel (frontend) and Render (backend).

title: AI Health Assistant – Generative AI Symptom Analyzer
description: Built an AI-powered app to analyze symptoms via text or PDF and recommend nearby specialized hospitals. Integrated Gemini API, Google Maps API, and built modular REST APIs with responsive multi-step UI.

title: Newzzy
description: Newzzy is a full-stack news aggregation and recommendation platform built with the MERN stack. The application utilizes a React and Vite frontend styled with Tailwind CSS, while Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB power the backend architecture. It aggregates real-time news feeds using the NewsData.io API and leverages keyword extraction algorithms to deliver personalized content recommendations to users. Additionally, the system secures user data and accounts using JSON Web Tokens (JWT), bcrypt password hashing, and Cloudinary for media management.
highlights:
• Implemented real-time news curation by integrating the NewsData.io API and utilizing keyword extraction algorithms to generate personalized user recommendations.
• Secured the platform by implementing multi-layered authentication and authorization using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and bcrypt password hashing.
• Designed a decoupled architecture by deploying a React frontend on Vercel and separate Express/Node.js servers on Render with MongoDB database integration.

title: tts_avatar
description: This web-based application implements a real-time text-to-speech avatar using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. The project renders an interactive digital avatar that synchronizes its movements with generated speech in real time. The architecture leverages client-side web technologies to deliver responsive avatar animations directly in the browser. Developers can easily reference a deployed live preview and an accompanying instructional video tutorial.
highlights:
• Renders a real-time, web-based text-to-speech avatar using client-side JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Integrates automated lip-syncing capabilities to dynamically align the avatar's animations with spoken audio.
• Provides a fully functional live preview deployment and a video tutorial detailing the project's setup and implementation.

title: ai-interviewer
description: AI Interviewer is a multi-tenant web platform designed to orchestrate structured technical and non-technical interviews with AI-assisted evaluation. The backend leverages FastAPI and Python to manage core domains, utilizing PostgreSQL for transactional data, Redis for caching, Celery for background tasks, and Qdrant for vector search. The frontend uses React, TypeScript, and Vite to deliver an interactive interface for candidates and reviewers. Additionally, the platform secures code execution via dockerized sandboxes and supports advisory proctoring workflows with audit trails.
highlights:
• Implements strict multi-tenant isolation to secure data access and manage tenant-scoped knowledge bases.
• Executes candidate submissions securely within dockerized, isolated sandbox environments supporting Python, C++, and Java.
• Utilizes Qdrant vector search and LLM integration to power adaptive question generation and rubric-based feedback.
• Integrates advisory proctoring event logging and mandates human-in-the-loop review to prevent autonomous hiring decisions.

title: ping_pong
description: PaddleLink Ping Pong is a motion-controlled table tennis game that transforms a user's smartphone into a physical game paddle using the DeviceMotion API. The project features a monorepo architecture divided into a mobile progressive web application controller, a desktop browser game display, a shared configurations package, and a WebSocket server. It leverages TypeScript across all packages, Vite for application bundling, and HTML Canvas for rendering the game on the desktop. The entire system communicates in real-time via WebSockets and deploys as separate containerized services using Docker.
highlights:
• Integrates the DeviceMotion API to capture physical phone swings and tilts for real-time, motion-controlled game input.
• Utilizes a multi-package monorepo structure that separates the codebase into a mobile controller, a desktop display, a central WebSocket server, and a shared types package.
• Employs dedicated Dockerfiles for each service to support containerized, multi-service production deployments on Railway.

title: AI_Brain_Tumour_Detector
description: This project implements an automated deep learning pipeline in Python and PyTorch to detect and classify brain tumors from MRI scans into four distinct categories. The system utilizes a ResNet50 transfer learning architecture fine-tuned with ImageNet pretrained weights and a custom linear classification head. It integrates advanced image preprocessing techniques, such as automatic brain region extraction, CLAHE contrast enhancement, and data augmentation, to prepare over 7,000 MRI images for training. Finally, the pipeline evaluates performance using scikit-learn and matplotlib to generate comprehensive classification reports and confusion matrices.
highlights:
• Achieved a 99.77% classification accuracy across four distinct categories on a test dataset of over 1,300 MRI images.
• Designed an automated preprocessing pipeline that removes black borders through brain region extraction and improves feature visibility using CLAHE contrast enhancement.
• Configured a robust training process in PyTorch utilizing the Adam optimizer, CrossEntropyLoss, and a ReduceLROnPlateau learning rate scheduler over 25 epochs.

title: log-generator
description: Log-generator is a high-performance Go-based utility designed to stress-test ELK and OpenSearch pipelines by generating high-volume, realistic log streams. The architecture coordinates a configurable pool of worker goroutines that push logs through a buffered channel to a central writer utilizing a 256KB buffered I/O system. It leverages optimization strategies like zero-allocation hot paths, lock-free atomic counters, and a tick-based token bucket to maintain precise rate limiting. Users can deploy the system as a highly portable 3MB static binary or a minimal Docker container under 10MB.
highlights:
• Sustains generation rates of 500,000 to over 1,000,000 logs per second on modern hardware by implementing a zero-allocation hot path that avoids JSON marshaling and string formatting.
• Features a highly concurrent design that distributes loads across custom worker pools and utilizes tick-based token buckets for smooth rate-limited output.
• Optimizes output performance using precomputed payloads, per-worker pre-allocated random fields, and a 256KB write buffer with periodic flushes.

title: code_editor
description: Built a web-based code editor using React, Monaco Editor, and Vite to replicate the LeetCode platform's user interface and functionality. The application implements client-side routing with React Router to enable direct, URL-based navigation and browser history support for over 2,900 coding problems. It utilizes Vite's eager loading capabilities to build an in-memory cache of problem data, ensuring instant problem switching without runtime network requests. The responsive, dark-themed split-panel UI displays problem descriptions alongside a multi-language editor with auto-complete and starter code templates.
highlights:
• Integrated Monaco Editor to deliver a VS Code-like browser editing experience with syntax highlighting and auto-complete for eight programming languages.
• Developed an in-memory caching system utilizing Vite's eager imports to load and map more than 2,900 LeetCode problems from local JSON files.
• Implemented client-side routing using React Router DOM to support URL-based navigation, seamless browser history integration, and shareable links.

title: Resume Parser
description: Smart Resume Parser automatically extracts structured data from native PDFs, scanned documents, and Word files using intelligent layout detection and fine-tuned Named Entity Recognition (NER) models. The system utilizes a FastAPI-based RESTful API and a layout detector to analyze document complexity, routing files to dedicated PDF, OCR, or DOCX processing pipelines. It leverages PyMuPDF, EasyOCR, and python-docx for text extraction, employing a fallback pipeline with adaptive thresholds for robust error recovery.
highlights:
• Achieves 90-95% section accuracy by using vertical projection histogram analysis and Y-overlap calculations to parse multi-column and hybrid layouts.
• Implements fine-tuned Transformer models to extract detailed entities, including experience timelines, roles, skills, and contact information.
• Features dynamic pipeline routing that automatically detects native text, scanned images, or DOCX styles to process files with the optimal technology stack.

title: chatbot
description: This enterprise-grade chatbot system provides context-aware, department-specific query routing and answering. The system features a FastAPI backend and a React-TypeScript frontend, utilizing PostgreSQL for relational data and ChromaDB as a vector database. It leverages an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline to automatically retrieve and process relevant context from uploaded documents and knowledge bases.
highlights:
• Engineered a hybrid routing system that combines semantic embeddings with keyword-based matching to dynamically direct queries to appropriate departments.
• Implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline using ChromaDB to index and retrieve context from uploaded PDF and DOCX documents.
• Designed a secure conversation manager that supports up to 25 turns of multi-turn conversation while enforcing PII protection and organization name anonymization.

title: custom_logstash
description: This project implements a custom plugin for Logstash to extend its functionality. Developed with Ruby and Shell, the codebase supports integration with both local Logstash clones and installed Logstash instances. The development workflow utilizes JRuby and Bundler to manage project dependencies and execute testing. Additionally, the system automatically converts inline source code comments into Asciidoc and HTML formats to generate centralized documentation.
highlights:
• Utilizes RSpec for unit testing and custom shell scripts to execute integration tests against specific Elasticsearch versions.
• Provides flexible deployment workflows, allowing installation either via direct Gemfile path configuration or by building and installing a custom Gem.
• Automates documentation generation by parsing and converting inline source code comments into Asciidoc and HTML formats.

title: ai-health-assistant
description: AI Health Assistant is a stateless full-stack web application that provides preliminary symptom analysis and recommends nearby specialized hospitals. The frontend, built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, guides users through a multi-step interface to share their location and symptoms via text or PDF file upload. The backend, powered by Node.js and Express, leverages Google's Gemini AI to analyze symptoms and uses the Google Maps API to search for relevant nearby medical facilities.
highlights:
• Implements a round-robin approach to cycle through up to 20 Google Gemini API keys to manage generative AI symptom analysis requests.
• Integrates the Google Maps API to perform reverse geocoding of coordinates and discover specialized hospitals within a configurable search radius.
• Supports document processing by utilizing Multer and pdf-parse to extract and analyze symptoms directly from uploaded PDF files.

title: Court_Case_Management
description: CourtWise Harmony is a web application that streamlines legal case management, communication, and scheduling for legal professionals, clients, and court staff. Built with React and TypeScript using Vite, the application implements a client-side architecture featuring React Router DOM and the React Context API for state management. It integrates Firebase to handle secure user authentication, database operations, and core backend services. The responsive user interface leverages Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components to deliver tailored dashboard views and interactive scheduling calendars.
highlights:
• Implements role-based workflows and dedicated views specifically tailored for plaintiffs, defense counsel, and court clerks to manage cases and assignments.
• Integrates Firebase to manage secure user authentication and database storage.
• Utilizes a modern frontend stack featuring React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI to build a responsive, component-driven user interface.

title: fresh-cart
description: Fresh Cart is a React-based web application designed to facilitate user account management, list creation, and order tracking. Built using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, the frontend utilizes the Create React App framework for its structure and build system. The application supports mobile and OTP-based user authentication, enabling both new registrations and access via preset dummy profiles.
highlights:
• Features an authentication workflow that allows users to sign in using mobile phone numbers and one-time passwords (OTP).
• Enables the management of user-specific data, including preset shopping lists and order details.
• Leverages Create React App scripts to build, test, and deploy optimized production bundles.

title: AI_CIBIL_Predictor
description: This project evaluates multiple regression models within a Jupyter Notebook environment to predict an individual's CIBIL score based on financial and personal features such as income, credit history, and loan details. The workflow implements and compares eleven different regression algorithms, including Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, CatBoost, and LightGBM. The pipeline utilizes pandas and numpy for data handling, scikit-learn for model training, and matplotlib and seaborn for visualization. The system evaluates model performance using Mean Squared Error (MSE), R-squared (R²), and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) to determine the most accurate predictor.
highlights:
• Implemented and benchmarked eleven different regression models, including Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Support Vector Regression.
• Evaluated model performance across Mean Squared Error, R-squared, and Mean Absolute Error metrics to identify Gradient Boosting as the optimal model for CIBIL score prediction.
• Utilized pandas, numpy, and scikit-learn to process financial indicators and train the machine learning models.

title: AI_traffic_Automation
description: This smart traffic management system dynamically adjusts traffic light timings based on real-time traffic data to optimize flow and reduce congestion. The system utilizes computer vision and sensors to analyze vehicle density at intersections and implements machine learning algorithms to predict traffic patterns. Built with Python in a Google Colab environment, the project integrates OpenCV, YOLO, and TensorFlow to detect standard vehicles and prioritize emergency vehicles.
highlights:
• Employs OpenCV and YOLO for real-time vehicle detection and density analysis at road intersections.
• Implements machine learning algorithms to predict congestion and dynamically adjust traffic signal durations to minimize wait times.
• Features an emergency vehicle detection system designed to automatically provide priority clearance and clear passage.
